Thanks again for taking the time to run through the pilot today, Alicia — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- What we heard: ACME is validating clinical summarization workflows for the patient intake team. Priority is accuracy + latency under 1s/response for short summaries.
- Current pilot setup: hosted Redwood endpoint, default quantization, 100k free pilot credits (nearing depletion).
- Open items: true daily token burn and peak TPS to size an extension; target unit economics (what $/1M tokens maps to production cost), extension approval if needed.

Can you please confirm (quick answers are fine):
1) Current average tokens/day for the pilot and typical tokens/request (or sample request counts)?
2) Your target budget range for production ($/month) or a target $/1M tokens you want to hit so we can map recommendations?
3) Any immediate blockers besides credits (compliance, VPC, SSO)?

Based on our quick calc we can map token burn to projected monthly costs and propose either a short credit extension (250-500k tokens) or a pricing estimate if you plan to scale. If helpful I can run a short projection and loop in Rishi for approvals.

Next steps: please reply with the tokens/day and anything else above by end of week; I’ll get you a projection and proposed credit extension.

Thanks,

Thanks for the fast follow-up and the CSV, Alicia — that helps a lot. I ran a quick projection based on the numbers you sent (attached projection workbook). Summary below: 

- Current weekly burn (avg 7d): ~86.8k tokens/week (~12.4k/day).
- At current rate, ~500k credits will last ~40 days; 250k ~20 days.
- Rough unit-econ mapping: Redwood hosted list for comparable models is around $1,000–$1,500 per 1M tokens depending on model/throughput. For planning I used $1,200 / 1M tokens as a mid-point.
  - At $1,200 / 1M tokens, your current 12.4k tokens/day equates to ~$15 / month (pilot scale). For a 100k/day sustained workload the same rate would be ~$3,600 / month.

Options we can move on immediately: 
1) Short extension: approve 500k pilot credits and extend the pilot by ~40 days at current burn to finish accuracy checks.
2) Smaller extension: 250k credits for ~20 days while you ramp concurrency tests.
3) Walkthrough on cost-optimization: Priyom can run quick batching/quantization suggestions to reduce tokens/request by ~20-30%.

If you’d like the extension, I can submit for approval today — Rishi, can you approve a 500k credit extension for ACME? If approved I’ll apply the credits and share updated usage dashboard and projection.

Thanks — attaching pilot_projection.xlsx with the math and a short recommendation.

Best,
